notes: Sheet drawn rotated (north arrow points right). Big block 2 lies between Colerain and Hanfield with no cross streets, so Jerome, Georgia and Florida end at Hanfield (T). Chase Av.: only its west face is drawn (x~6166-6178), the east face is off the right edge; centre taken 30 ft (180 px) east of the west face, which matches the 6" water pipe at x~6355. Whether Jerome, Georgia, Florida and Kirby continue east of Chase cannot be seen, so the Chase crossings are recorded as T. Virginia (45') crosses the top-right corner; Chase starts at it. Hanfield printed bare (HANFIELD). Alleys, all 12': two unnamed N-S alleys printed just 'ALLEY' run through block 4 from Jerome to Georgia and line up with HEMLOCK and CYPRESS in block 5 (recorded as alley segments, with Hemlock/Cypress crossing Georgia as 'cross'); MARBLE ALLEY joins the two block-4 alleys; AGATE ALLEY joins Hemlock and Cypress. In block 6 an unnamed 12' stub continues Hemlock south of Florida and dead-ends at a lot line at y~6406. Kirby is very slightly flatter west of Hanfield (no bend recorded).
